answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital ownership. An attacker attempting to simulate a willow-like network of false agents must stake significant assets, which are slashed upon malicious behavior. A zephyr of fake identities remains ineffective without underlying financial skin in the game. By requiring a cryptographic cipher to sign state transitions, the system binds identity to economic cost, rendering massive account forgery prohibitively expensive.
